def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    result_index = pd.Index(entity_ids)

    # Только покупки, произошедшие до seed_time
    past_items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=result_index)

    zero_cols = [
        "total_items_sold", "total_orders_sold", "total_customers",
        "avg_price", "avg_freight", "min_price", "max_price", "std_price",
        "total_price", "total_revenue", "days_since_last", "span_days",
        "sales_last_30d", "orders_last_30d",
        "sales_last_60d", "orders_last_60d",
        "sales_last_90d", "orders_last_90d",
        "sales_last_180d", "orders_last_180d",
        "avg_review_score", "review_count", "avg_review_score_180d",
        "avg_interval_days", "share_last_90", "had_sales", "sales_per_day",
        "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments", "share_credit_card",
        "sales_momentum_30_90", "days_since_first",
    ]
    for col in zero_cols:
        result[col] = 0

    if len(past_items) == 0:
        return result.reindex(result_index)

    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id"]]
    merged = past_items.merge(orders_sub, on="order_id", how="left")
    merged["price_freight"] = merged["price"] + merged["freight_value"]

    grp = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_items_sold=("price_freight", "count"),
        total_orders_sold=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_revenue=("price_freight", "sum"),
        first_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_ts=("ts", "max"),
    )

    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (merged["ts"] >= start) & (merged["ts"] < seed_time)
        win = merged[mask]
        grp[f"sales_last_{window}d"] = win.groupby("product_id").size()
        grp[f"orders_last_{window}d"] = win.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже опубликованы к моменту seed_time
    rev_ok = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "review_score"]
    ]
    review_joined = past_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        rev_ok, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    if len(review_joined) > 0:
        rev_agg = review_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            review_count=("review_score", "count"),
        )
        start180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
        rev_recent = review_joined.merge(
            past_items[["order_id"]].drop_duplicates().assign(ts=None),
            on="order_id", how="left"
        )
        # свежесть отзыва определяем по дате создания отзыва
        rev_with_date = past_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
            reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][
                ["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date"]
            ], on="order_id", how="inner"
        )
        rev_recent = rev_with_date[rev_with_date["review_creation_date"] >= start180]
        rev_recent_agg = rev_recent.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].mean().rename(
            "avg_review_score_180d"
        )
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["avg_review_score", "review_count"], index=grp.index
        )
        rev_recent_agg = pd.Series(dtype=float, name="avg_review_score_180d")

    grp = grp.join(rev_agg, how="left")
    grp = grp.join(rev_recent_agg, how="left")

    # Платежи: только по заказам, купленным до seed_time
    pay_ok = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "payment_value", "payment_installments", "payment_type"]
    ]
    pay_joined = past_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        pay_ok, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    if len(pay_joined) > 0:
        pay_agg = pay_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        )
        cc_share = (
            pay_joined.assign(is_cc=(pay_joined["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(float))
            .groupby("product_id")["is_cc"].mean().rename("share_credit_card")
        )
    else:
        pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["avg_payment_value", "avg_installments"], index=grp.index
        )
        cc_share = pd.Series(dtype=float, name="share_credit_card")
    grp = grp.join(pay_agg, how="left")
    grp = grp.join(cc_share, how="left")

    grp["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - grp["last_ts"]).dt.days
    grp["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - grp["first_ts"]).dt.days
    grp["span_days"] = (grp["last_ts"] - grp["first_ts"]).dt.days

    order_ts = merged[["product_id", "order_id", "ts"]].drop_duplicates()

    def avg_interval(s):
        s = s.sort_values()
        if len(s) < 2:
            return np.nan
        return s.diff().dropna().dt.days.mean()

    grp["avg_interval_days"] = order_ts.groupby("product_id")["ts"].apply(avg_interval)

    grp["sales_per_day"] = grp["total_orders_sold"] / grp["span_days"].replace(0, np.nan)
    grp["sales_per_day"] = grp["sales_per_day"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    grp["share_last_90"] = grp["orders_last_90d"] / grp["total_orders_sold"]
    grp["sales_momentum_30_90"] = grp["sales_last_30d"] / grp["sales_last_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    grp["sales_momentum_30_90"] = grp["sales_momentum_30_90"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    result = grp.reindex(result_index).fillna(0)
    result["had_sales"] = (result["total_orders_sold"] > 0).astype(float)

    return result
